title: Escort iX Review: Radar Detecor Review by Vortex Radar
snippet:
Escort Max2The Max2 came out before the iX, but Escort has since discontinued the Max2 and effectively replaced it by the iX. The Max2 had virtually all the same features (except for an earlier generation magnetic mount), but better performance and better filtering… plus you could find it online for less than the iX even though the MSRP of the Max2 was $100 more than the iX. However, the Max2 is now discontinued, the price is now sky high (the only people selling one are those asking ridiculous [...] If you don’t need the RLC alerts or manually marking GPS locations, save even more money and get the DFR6. It’s great at 34.7 which is what you’ll see the most of and you don’t need fancier K band filtering.  If you want something newer, DFR8. 

      If you want the RLC alerts, spring for the DFR7. It is being discontinued soon though so it’ll be gone very soon.  If you want the newer version, DFR9.
